# Security policy

## Supported versions

Security fixes go into the latest release only.

## Reporting a vulnerability

Do not open a public issue. Report it privately, either way:

- [GitHub private vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/yuna0x0/watari-basis/security/advisories/new)
- E-mail `security@yuna0x0.com`, encrypted with [this PGP key](https://yuna0x0.com/yuna0x0.asc)
  if needed

Include:

- the Watari version
- what the issue is and who it affects
- steps or a proof of concept

## Scope

In scope: Watari's code and its published packages (GitHub releases, `vpm.yuna0x0.com`,
OpenUPM). For example, an asset that makes a conversion run code or change files outside what
the conversion writes.

Out of scope: Basis, Unity, the VRChat SDK, VRCFury, Modular Avatar and UniVRM. Report those to
their own projects.

The policy for all yuna0x0 projects is at
[yuna0x0.com/posts/security](https://yuna0x0.com/posts/security/).
